_notes: Input of script/hardened/RedeployLayers.s.sol in REDEPLOY_MODE=layers for the redeploy of 2026-11-20, which puts the three code-review rounds of 2026-11-18 on both testnets (docs/redeploy-2026-11-gas.md, "The layers of 2026-11-20"). Eight creations on each chain at deployerNonce to deployerNonce + 7: ReceiptProofLib, OpeningProofLib, BeaconLayoutLib, MessageBridge, MediatorPayloads, TokenFactory, TokenMediator, DeliveryRouter (with its RouterCaller).

previous*: the bridge, mediator and router that run now, deployed on 2026-11-11 (deploy/deployments/archive/sepolia-pls943.2026-11-11.json, which is deploy/deployments/sepolia-pls943.json until this run). The script reads from them every value that the new contracts keep: the light clients, the gate, the Capella era and the send cutoff of the bridge, the flow limiter and the home chain name of the mediator, the wrapped native token, the reward and the failed delivery addresses of the router. The gates, light clients, fork registry and verifiers stay.

deployerNonce: 45 on both chains, read on 2026-11-20 with `cast nonce 0xF71cBAA5a165fad2FfFf6B0D68E84D67b1f75eAc --rpc-url <alias>`. Equal nonces give every new contract one address on both chains. The script refuses a nonce that differs from the chain's, because the bridges and the mediators name their twins on the other chain by predicted address. Send nothing else from the deployer before the run (tFAU comes after it, at nonce 53).
deployer: the testnet deployer 0xF71cBAA5a165fad2FfFf6B0D68E84D67b1f75eAc (1Password vault zkb.fi, item "testnet deployer wallet"). The script refuses another signer.
Foundry resolves rpcAlias from FOUNDRY_RPC_ENDPOINTS, as for DeployBridge (docs/testnet-run.md). Never write a key into this file.
